description: Contract version 6 (NEW UPDATE 4, 2026-11-11): version 5 plus the events of LynkAttend, LynkQueue and LynkSurvey. No PIN, IDCN, ID number, face or finger pattern, phone number, position or anonymous identity is ever part of an event. Upcaster 5 to 6 in contract/upcasters.v1.json only raises the version.

p256_public_key.description: Uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes), base64url, no padding.

money.description: Integer minor units of the payload's currency.

period.description: A year, a month or a day.

username.description: The shared username rule (blueprint 44 B, core/usernames.py).

side.description: Which side of the service the event belongs to: internal (the workspace) or external (the Storefront). Missing means internal.

ShipmentCreated.note: A shipment exists (LOSHP-): one or more pieces sent by the business's own rider, a partner carrier or an agency.

ShipmentScanned.note: A piece was scanned at a step; the place is a registered hub or pickup point, never a position.

ShipmentHandedOver.note: Custody passed from one party to the next; seal is the hash of the sealed hand-over batch (services/sealing.py), so the Proof Chain can be checked by QR.

ShipmentExceptionRaised.note: Something went wrong, always with the next step the receiver or sender is offered.

DeliveryAttempted.note: A delivery attempt that did not end in a hand-over.

DeliveryRescheduled.note: The receiver chose a new time, a pickup point or a new place (through the cloud, from the tracking page, USSD or text).

ZoneEntered.note: A tracked subject entered a zone; worked out on the device or the cloud, never sent as a position.

ZoneLeft.note: A tracked subject left a zone.

AssetRegistered.note: A vehicle or asset is protected (LOAST-). Hardware is only on demand; the phone is the default tracker.

AssetTripStarted.note: A trip of an asset began (LOTRP-).

AssetTripEnded.note: A trip of an asset ended: whole metres and seconds.

RentalStarted.note: A rental began after the renter was told the vehicle is tracked during the rental; hand-over photos are sealed.

RentalEnded.note: A rental ended; tracking for the renter stops here.

ProtectionAlertRaised.note: A LynkSentry alert (never the platform's AlertRaised). LynkSentry never contacts police by itself.

ProtectionAlertCleared.note: An alert was cleared, for example "Yes, it is me".

SentryIncidentOpened.note: An incident room opened (LOSNT-); it goes to the safety desk. Never the platform status incident (INC).

SentryIncidentClosed.note: An incident was closed by its owner.

LocationShareStarted.note: A person started sharing with people they chose, under a consent record with an end time.

LocationShareEnded.note: A share ended; nothing more is shared from here.

TripPlanSet.note: A trip plan with a check-in deadline; the cloud watches it, so it works even if the phone dies.

TripPlanCheckedIn.note: The person checked in on time.

TripPlanOverdue.note: The deadline passed with no check-in; trusted contacts are told (cloud only).

DeviceLastReport.note: A device's last sealed report before it went quiet, with the reason, so owners know why.

CardRequested.note: A person asked for a card of one group, online only. The form's details (load amount, account, income, consent) go to the licensed partner directly and never into an event.

CardRequestConfirmed.note: Cloud only: the licensed partner issued the card. For a credit card, credit_limit is the integer amount the lender granted.

CardRequestFailed.note: Cloud only: the partner did not issue the card, with the reason shown to the person.

AttendancePersonRegistered.note: A manager registered a person with their set. The ID number and the IDCN made from it go to the protected store, never into an event.

AttendanceSetChanged.note: The manager changed a person's set, with the person's agreement.

AttendanceConsentRecorded.note: The person agreed: the use of their face or finger if in their set, and that sharing a PIN or IDCN is cheating.

BiometricEnrolled.note: Face or Finger was enrolled on the organisation's own device. The pattern stays encrypted on that device and is never in an event.

AttendancePinCreated.note: Cloud only: LynkOmni created the person's 6-digit PIN. The PIN is never in an event.

AttendancePinSent.note: Cloud only: the PIN and IDCN were sent to the person's own contact.

AttendancePinShown.note: Cloud only: a manager pressed Show; every view is recorded.

AttendancePinBlocked.note: The PIN was blocked; it is never used again.

AttendancePinRecreated.note: Cloud only: a new PIN replaced a blocked one.

CheckedIn.note: A person checked in at a registered door device. The time is the door device's.

CheckedOut.note: A person checked out; minutes is the time since check-in.

CheckInFlagged.note: A record was flagged for the manager. It is only a flag, never an accusation.

AttendanceCorrected.note: The manager corrected a record with a reason; the old record is kept.

VisitorSignedIn.note: Door staff signed in a visitor after checking their ID document; with none, the manager allowed it. The ID number is never in an event.

VisitorDecision.note: The manager allowed or refused a visitor without an ID document.

AttendanceRequestRaised.note: Cloud only: the person asked for deletion or raised a dispute from My details; the manager is told.

AttendanceDetailsDeleted.note: Cloud only: all of a person's details were deleted; hours records the law requires stay without personal details.

FireListOpened.note: The fire list of everyone inside was opened.

TicketIssued.note: A ticket was given out. The number shown is section and code; the code is never used twice for that section at that place.

TicketCalled.note: A counter called a ticket (Call next, or Call again).

TicketSentTo.note: Send to: the same ticket and the same arrival time in the next section.

TicketPutBack.note: Reception put a missed ticket back, after the next 3 people.

TicketPriorityMarked.note: Reception marked a ticket as priority.

TicketRunningLate.note: The person moved back a few places, once per ticket.

TicketNotServedToday.note: Cloud only: still waiting at closing; closed by itself.

CounterStateChanged.note: A counter opened, paused or closed.

QueueKeeperChanged.note: Another device in the building became the queue keeper.

TicketCodesReserved.note: Cloud only: a block of codes was set aside for one device to use if it is cut off.

TicketCodesVoided.note: Unused codes of a block were closed with a reason; they are never reused.

SurveySaved.note: A survey or a new version of it was saved; once answers arrive, a change makes a new version.

SurveyApproval.note: An approver approved or sent back a survey.

SurveyStateChanged.note: A survey opened, paused, closed or went into test mode.

SurveyAnswered.note: One answer from a device (kiosk, POS screen, field interview, paper entry). Never who answered an anonymous survey.

SurveyAnswerReceived.note: Cloud only: an answer arrived online (link, chat, text, voice, email). Its content is stored with the answer, never who answered an anonymous survey.

SurveyAnswerChecked.note: Cloud only: the real-answers check; please_check stays apart until the manager decides.

SurveyAnswerDeleted.note: Cloud only: the person deleted their own (non-anonymous) answer.

SurveyOptOut.note: Cloud only: the person pressed Don't ask me again for an organisation.

SurveyCallBack.note: A Call back task for an unhappy person who agreed to be contacted.

SurveyRewardRequested.note: Cloud only: a reward was asked of the payment partner after the answer passed the check.

SurveyCashRewardRecorded.note: A field worker gave a cash reward; integer minor units with the currency.

PanelMembership.note: Cloud only: a person joined or left the LynkSurvey Panel; leaving deletes their panel details.

SurveyResultsVerified.note: Cloud only: the results report and its research record were sealed for the check link.
